argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap"
test -d "$ROOT/.git" || git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$ROOT"
git -C "$ROOT" fetch --prune origin main
git -C "$ROOT" checkout --detach origin/main
export ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science
bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bootstrap_chatgpt_terminal_pull.sh"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now hive-pipe-agent.service hive-pipe-gateway.service one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer one-wave-route-goblin.timer
systemctl --user restart hive-pipe-agent.service hive-pipe-gateway.service one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service || true
systemctl --user restart hive-pipe-relay.service || true
python3 "$ROOT/hive-pipe/route_goblin.py" || true
python3 "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bridge_lattice_watchdog.py" || true
printf 'BRIDGE_RECOVERY_RECEIPT\n'
for s in hive-pipe-agent.service hive-pipe-gateway.service hive-pipe-relay.service one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer one-wave-route-goblin.timer; do printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl --user is-active "$s" || true; done
printf 'GEMINI='; command -v gemini || test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/gemini" && printf '%s\n' "$HOME/.local/bin/gemini"
printf 'GEMINI_TOKEN='; test -s "$HOME/.config/hive-pipe/tokens/gemini.token" && echo PRESENT || echo MISSING
printf 'RELAY_ENV='; test -s "$HOME/.config/hive-pipe/relay.env" && echo PRESENT || echo MISSING
printf 'BRIDGE_COMMIT='; git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SCIENCE_HEAD='; git -C /home/Scales/One-Wave-Science rev-parse HEAD
intention: Recover the Jetson-native pull/gateway/relay control plane without Desktop Commander, verify protected credential presence without exposing values, and prepare the existing Gemini CLI worker.
consequence: Restarts all locally recoverable bridge services and returns only service/credential-presence receipts; no secret values are printed and no science files are edited.
